title: Night Garden — portfolio parallax assets
export: Garden layers upscaled from 1024 × 1536 generated originals with high-quality Core Graphics resampling.

archPreview.shape: Semicircular upper arch of radius 300 px, spring line at y=300 px; transparent outside; no frame.

animatedInsects.origin: Placement centers in full-scene pixels, top-left origin. Rotation is CSS clockwise degrees.

parallax.edgeHandling: Clip all layers to the same arch; use scale(1.08) around center before translating to cover outer-frame edges.
parallax.staticInspection: Opposite extremes rendered at layer translations of 0/15/30/45/60 px horizontally and 0/9/18/27/36 px vertically. This is an image-composite inspection, not a live browser test.
parallax.smallMotion: Use much smaller travel in the website hero, and respect reduced-motion preferences.
